note: Paired fixed-slot training on fold0/seed3/BLCA. Arms differ ONLY in which two slots survive the native top-k readout. The override is a forward_hook on the native pred_keep_slot output adding a DETACHED constant bias, so the native forward, top-k, gate, and gradient topology are unmodified. Plan does not read patient tensors; only --run trains.
